evidence: mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/navigation/Navigation.kt:541 — the realtor ListingAnalytics composable loads portfolio analytics via portalListingsRepository.getPortfolioAnalytics() (:513) and on failure does `.onFailure { metrics = emptyList() }` (:541). ListingAnalyticsScreen is then rendered with metrics=emptyList() and isLoading=false, so a network failure or a 401 (signed-out/expired session) produces an all-empty analytics dashboard that is indistinguishable from a realtor who genuinely has zero views/inquiries/favorites. There is no errorMessage state, no ErrorContent, and no retry affordance on this screen.

This is NOT the documented-intent sibling: the MyListings composable (Navigation.kt:466 `.onFailure { listings = emptyList() }`) carries an explicit comment (:457-460) stating the empty state is a deliberate fallback incl. the 401 case. The ListingAnalytics onFailure has no such comment and no empty-vs-error distinction, so a transient backend outage silently tells the realtor their marketing performance is zero. The module already has the right pattern elsewhere — InquiriesScreen.kt:168-180 renders ErrorContent(message=errorMessage!!, onRetry={…}) — so the fix is a local mirror.

Severity LOW (+1): no crash, no security impact, realtor-only screen; it is a UX/error-surfacing gap (misleading zero-state on load failure with no retry). Confidence medium: the silent failure->empty mapping is confirmed by static read of the LaunchedEffect; it was not runtime-verified and the exact user-visible copy on ListingAnalyticsScreen for an empty metrics list was not inspected this pass.

Not a duplicate: distinct from code-review-mobile-native-kmp-portfolio-analytics-caps-100 / -unbounded-fanout / -drops-view-zero-days (all about the repository aggregation math in PortalListingsRepository.getPortfolioAnalytics) — this finding is about the UI call site swallowing the Result.failure with no error surface.
